knowledge_cards.title: One-lead assumption is a dataset convention
Lead detection is not processing authority
Spatial release is spectrum geometry and listener dependent
Binaural predictions do not transfer directly to stereo mix rules
Level-only is required for de-masking evaluation
Dynamic de-masking may preserve apparent balance better than a level lift
Prototype limits and timing are not universal settings

rules.when_to_apply: a guitar alternates among accompaniment hook fill and solo roles
rules.what_to_change: create a phrase/section role map and allow uncertain or co-lead states before proposing processing
rules.suggested_range: categorical role plus confidence; no automatic dB or EQ values
rules.range_origin: frame-level lead detection task and project safety policy
rules.verify: compare with Dmitry's full-arrangement role annotations
rules.undo_when: activity or loudness is mistaken for leadership or co-leads are suppressed

rules.when_to_apply: an analysis model labels a track as lead
rules.what_to_change: expose the label only as evidence and require a separate decision for every mix action
rules.verify: blind full-mix comparison with no-action and human-map baselines
rules.undo_when: a reviewed project-specific policy validates a narrow role-action link

rules.when_to_apply: a foreground phrase is audible in solo but masked in the arrangement
rules.what_to_change: test the smallest section-local level move before spectral compensation and retain no-processing as a candidate
rules.suggested_range: ear-led sweep around current balance; study +3 dB is not a default
rules.range_origin: level-only study baseline and conservative test design
rules.verify: loudness-matched full-mix A/B for intelligibility naturalness and balance similarity
rules.undo_when: the phrase becomes oversized section contrast collapses or limiter behaviour shifts

rules.when_to_apply: level restores audibility but damages balance and target/masker tracks are separate
rules.what_to_change: compare bounded target-side dynamic de-masking with level-only and complementary masker-dip variants
rules.suggested_range: start at zero and stop at first stable preference; do not transplant prototype gain/timing values
rules.range_origin: SMC prototype plus project-controlled A/B design
rules.verify: section-specific equal-final-loudness blind A/B plus target and masker solo checks
rules.undo_when: tone is hyped modulation is audible silent bands rise or level-only performs equally

rules.when_to_apply: pan interaural or HRTF processing is proposed for target-masker separation
rules.what_to_change: label the operator and playback domain and test stereo pan separately from binaural HRTF processing
rules.suggested_range: no source-backed pan angle or HRTF strength for rock mixing
rules.verify: separate headphone loudspeaker and mono listening with human ratings
rules.undo_when: benefit is playback-specific coloration appears or center/mono worsens

rules.when_to_apply: a spatial cue change is proposed as a clarity intervention
rules.what_to_change: inspect whether the cue change overlaps useful target energy rather than optimizing broadband width or correlation
rules.suggested_range: reference-relative frequency- and section-resolved comparison; no global target
rules.range_origin: HRTF study discussion and prior stereo-card constraints
rules.verify: bandwise diagnostics plus matched-loudness listening across positions and sections
rules.undo_when: clarity comes only from coloration level change or weakening a competing source

rules.when_to_apply: lead guitar competes with rhythm guitars vocal or another foreground element
rules.what_to_change: evaluate role/arrangement then balance then section automation then bounded collision processing then playback-specific spatial option
rules.suggested_range: one controlled variable per comparison; no universal values
rules.range_origin: cross-source synthesis and existing project cards
rules.verify: loudness-matched blind comparisons on verse chorus and solo with Dmitry acceptance
rules.undo_when: a later stage adds no stable preference over a simpler earlier baseline

reference_cards.license: home-studio and educational use only; no commercial use; attribution required

handoff: Treat lead guitar as a phrase/section role, not a permanent track privilege. Compare no action and the smallest local level move first; only then test bounded dynamic de-masking or playback-specific spatial separation. Do not transplant HRTF results or prototype timing/gain limits.
